title: Derived normalization by the quotient tensor map
statement: Use the coefficient constructions [def-kun-prime-coefficient-constructions] and termwise normalization [def-kun-prime-coefficient-termwise-normalization]. Given a scheme $V$, a coefficient homomorphism $\varphi:A\to B$, an $A$-sheaf $M$, a $B$-sheaf $N$, $q:M\to UN$, derived objects $D,D^{\prime}$, degree-zero isomorphisms $\rho:D\cong Q_A(M[0])$, $\rho^{\prime}:D^{\prime}\cong Q_B(N[0])$, and a natural isomorphism $\Phi:D\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}U(-)\cong U(D^{\prime}\otimes_B^{\mathbf L}(-))$ of [def-kun-prime-coefficient-iso], say it is coefficient normalized if the canonical ordinary quotient tensor arrow $M\otimes_A UN\to U(q_\varphi(M)\otimes_B N)$ is an isomorphism and, for every cochain complex $C^\bullet$ of $B$-sheaves, there exists a termwise normalized chain map $t$ satisfying [def-kun-prime-coefficient-localization-compatibility]. Explicitly $(1\otimes\mathrm{fac}_{C^\bullet})(\rho\otimes1)\mu_{Q_A}Q_A(t)\mathrm{fac}^{-1}_{N[0]\otimes_B C^\bullet}=\Phi_{Q_B(C^\bullet)}U_D((\rho^{\prime}\otimes1)\mu_{Q_B})$, with $\mathrm{fac}:Q_B;U_D\cong U_C;Q_A$. This fixes the same $\Phi$ on all complex representatives, in particular every bounded-below complex and every degree-zero $Z[0]$.
